Middesk | Full-time | NYC / SF | Hybrid | middesk.com

At Middesk, we're building the business identity infrastructure that banks, fintechs, and platforms rely on to know who they're doing business with — powering KYB (Know Your Business) compliance, fraud prevention, and entity verification at scale.

We're expanding beyond verification into a full agentic compliance platform — orchestrators and specialist agents that automate what used to be manual compliance review. Backed by YC, Sequoia, and Accel (Series B).

We're a small, sharp team with high ownership — engineers work closely with customers and leadership, and get to see their work ship fast.
